llm_judge_reasons: All three instruction sub-goals are covered: Steinberg reference presence (0.4), '<add here>' marker removal (0.3), and footer page number (0.3).
Postconfig correctly saves the file with Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring fresh state is read.
Steinberg check ('Steinberg' in full_text) scans body paragraphs and is a reasonable proxy for reference list membership given the document context.
Placeholder removal check is semantically correct: if '<add here>' is gone the requirement is nominally met.
Footer page number check correctly looks for PAGE/NUMPAGES field codes in footer XML as the primary signal.
Minor issue: 'w:fldChar' in footer XML is a generic Word field character and would be triggered by any field (e.g., date, author), not only page-number fields; this is a potential false positive.

Minor issue: The plain-text fallback (any non-empty footer paragraph text passes) means adding arbitrary text to the footer would satisfy the page-number requirement without inserting an actual page-number field.
Minor issue: 'has_add_here_marker' check only verifies the placeholder was removed, not that a citation number was actually inserted in its place; deletion without replacement would also pass.
Metric parameter handling is correct: metric directly reads result keys and does not misuse the expected (rules dict) parameter.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Restrict 'w:fldChar' detection to known page-number field types, or only rely on explicit 'PAGE'/'NUMPAGES' instrText checks to avoid false positives from non-page fields.
Remove or gate the plain-text footer fallback: only accept footer content that contains PAGE/NUMPAGES instrText, to distinguish actual page-number fields from arbitrary footer text.

Optionally strengthen the citation insertion check: after '<add here>' is removed, verify that a numeric citation token (e.g., '[N]' or '(N)') appears in the nearby sentence to confirm a reference number was actually inserted.
